tags.name: Phone Filtering
tags.description: API endpoints for filtering and sorting phones

get.description: Returns a phone by id.

put.description: Updates phone by id, based on input data. Where field is empty, there will be no changes in this field.

get.description: Returns full product details required for admin overview and future edit form.

get.description: Returns a list of all users. Later there will be a lot of users, so for efficient work user retrieving should be pageable.

post.description: Creates new user based on input data. Email must be unique. Password and password confirmation must be equal. The user will have role: USER.

post.summary: temporal: Endpoint for creating fake users
post.description: Creates amount of fake users. This endpoint is going to be removed in the future. There is a limit to create at the same time: 1_000. For each generated user password is: Password1234!

post.summary: temporal: Endpoint for creating fake phones
post.description: Creates amount of fake phones. This endpoint is going to be removed in the future. There is a limit to create at the same time: 10_000.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of phones. Use 'page' and 'size' query parameters to control pagination.

post.description: Creates a new phone based on input data and also adds provided images. Images are optional.

get.description: Returns paginated public reviews for a phone.

post.description: Creates one review per authenticated user.
Adds one image for specified phone.

Decreases the quantity of an existing product in the user's cart by the specified amount. If the amount to remove is greater than or equal to the current quantity, the product is completely removed from the cart.
Adds a product to the authenticated user's cart. If the product is already in the cart, its quantity is increased by the specified amount.
Deletes all items from the authenticated user's cart.

Sends a password reset link to the email. Always returns 204 regardless of whether the email exists in the system.
